requirements.title: Nominal position accuracy
requirements.text: With nominal GNSS, the 95th-percentile horizontal position error shall not exceed 5.0 m.

requirements.title: GNSS outage holdover
requirements.text: During a 300 s GNSS outage, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 50 m using dead reckoning.

requirements.title: Accuracy under jamming
requirements.text: While GNSS noise is degraded to 25 m (1-sigma) by jamming, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 20 m.

requirements.title: Spoofing detection probability
requirements.text: A GNSS drag-off spoof moving the reported position at 0.5 m/s or faster shall be detected in at least 95% of runs.

requirements.title: Spoofing time to alert
requirements.text: The 95th-percentile time from spoof onset to integrity alarm shall not exceed 60 s.

requirements.title: Containment under spoofing
requirements.text: Throughout a spoofing attack, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 50 m.

requirements.title: False alarm rate
requirements.text: With nominal GNSS, integrity alarms shall occur no more than once per 10 hours of operation.

requirements.title: Processing time
requirements.text: One dead-reckoning prediction plus one GNSS update shall take no more than 1 ms on the reference machine.
